request.style: English, female voice, warm and uplifting, solo with subtle choir, acoustic guitar, piano, strings, soft drums, hopeful and reflective mood, 85 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Slaves to sin we used to be
Free from righteousness we were
Shamed by what we did
The end was death for us

[Chorus]
Wages of sin is death
But free gift of God
Eternal life in Christ
Jesus our Lord

[Verse]
Now set free from sin we stand
Slaves of God we have become
Fruit that leads to holiness
Its end is eternal life

[Chorus]
Wages of sin is death
But free gift of God
Eternal life in Christ
Jesus our Lord

[Bridge]
Shame is past and gone
We serve the Living God
Holiness grows in us
Life without end

[Chorus]
Wages of sin is death
But free gift of God
Eternal life in Christ
Jesus our Lord

[Outro]
Free gift of God
Eternal life
